title: Balance of payments of Country Z
body: The central bank of Country Z published the following summary of its balance of payments for the year, with all figures in million USD. Exports of goods were 300 and imports of goods were 410. Net invisibles, made up of net non-factor services, net income and net transfers, were +70. The capital account, which includes net foreign direct investment, net portfolio investment, net external commercial borrowings and net external assistance, showed a balance of +32. Errors and omissions were recorded as -2. The central bank follows the rule that any overall deficit in the balance of payments is settled through official reserve transactions, and any overall surplus is added to its foreign exchange reserves.
